matched512_ratios.definition: ZEKRA median divided by Binius median; each uses one excluded warmup plus five verified formal runs.

measurement.crypto_prove_ms: proof generation/transcript finalization, excluding witness filling/local checks
measurement.interpretation: net complete upstream/fork patch cost with identical current CFA code; no extrapolation to future backends
measurement.proof_bytes: actual serialized transcript bytes; every invocation verifies its own fresh proof
measurement.proof_retention: runner verifies the transcript in-process; it emits verified status and length, not the private proof transcript itself
measurement.prove_total_ms: witness filling/local checks plus cryptographic proof generation
measurement.rss: wait4 child high-water RSS: bytes on macOS, KiB converted to bytes on Linux; not process-group sum or macOS footprint
measurement.setup_ms: circuit construction plus verifier/prover preprocessing, excluding input loading/preflight
measurement.verify_ms: cryptographic verification and transcript finalization against independently reconstructed public inputs

matched512.timing_scope: setup excludes input loading/preflight; prove_total includes witness filling, local checks, and cryptographic proving; verify includes transcript finalization

membership.timing_scope: setup excludes input loading/preflight; prove_total includes witness filling, local checks, and cryptographic proving; verify includes transcript finalization

mode-auth.definition: Single observations per application/mode; aggregates summarize 21 different workloads, not repetitions. Fitted evaluation bundles sign previously acquired paths and do not establish challenge-before-capture.

metrics_scope.authority_provision_ms: One authority provisioning measurement for this fitted application/mode configuration.
metrics_scope.device_sign_ms: Device report construction and signing, including its required evidence/commitment work.
metrics_scope.public_preflight_ms: Native verifier public signature/challenge/configuration/ABI preflight; private handoff excluded.

zekra-matched512.proof_size_scope: Native libsnark reported group-element bit accounting, not serialized transcript bytes.
zekra-matched512.timing_scope: Native generator/prover/verifier phases; compilation, witness preparation and Docker launch excluded.

statistics: Five verified formal measurements per control; successful excluded warmup required. Mode application rows are single observations.
